clips.title: The story
paras: Cliffspring Falls pours from Darkshore’s eastern cliffs into the forest below. Its waters feed the Cliffspring River and once supplied nearby night elf settlements, but a foul taint now spreads through the river basin.

Cliffspring Falls pours from caves high in Darkshore’s eastern bluffs and feeds the Cliffspring River. The river winds west through the woods before emptying into the sea. Its clear waters once gave nearby night elf settlements their purest drinking water. Now they run murky and foul, spreading sickness and decay through the river basin. Naturalists investigating the falls have found the caves overrun by naga and cultists. They plot in the shadows, while demonic corruption from neighboring Felwood threatens to seep through the highland bedrock.
